fundamental.summary: CI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 50 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (418.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and post-FOMC volatility create severely adverse macro conditions; 50-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD bullish crossover with price above major moving averages and three white soldiers pattern offer technical entry signal in extreme fear environment (43 Fear/Greed) where contrarian opportunity exists.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum (Stoch, Williams %R), zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional buying, earnings in 50 days), crisis-level VIX (418.4), unfavorable macro (rising dollar, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), and weak trend confirmation (ADX false, Hull false, OBV false) create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh technical setup.
